newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies six muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies six muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said Monday it qualified for bond insurance the following six municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
-Allen Parish School District No 5, La., $3.5 million general obligation school bonds.
--Forest Park School District, Mich., $7.13 million school bonds.
--Marcellus Community School District, Mich., $3.53 million GOs.
--Otto Eldred School District, Pa., $4.39 million GOs, by direct purchase.
--Mansfield, Texas, $2.3 million water and sewer bonds.
